label: D1 after a reward, early in the episode, when the agent is about to choose a2
explanation: Fires only at D1, and only when the reward input is 1 (no activity at all on GO, D2 or unrewarded D1). Almost all activity (99.9%) comes when the upcoming GO choice is a2. This is the agent own upcoming choice, which it legitimately computes; no future random outcome is used. It is also restricted to early in the episode: none on trials 0-2, peak on trials 3-19, fading out by about 30, and essentially absent from 40 on (apart from a small blip at 90-99). So 92% of the mass is in episodes that start with S2 good. Within this regime it is a narrow hidden-state band: the D1 policy logit is mildly a2-leaning, between -4.4 and -1.5 (99.9% of mass), and the value is between 7.54 and 7.73 (91%). Magnitudes are tiny (max 0.03). The strongest activations come on the first rewarded D1s of an a2 streak early in the episode, and they decay over consecutive rewarded trials. Precision is only about 0.4-0.5: many early rewarded D1s before an a2 choice stay silent, so the feature tracks a specific early-episode, a2-committed state of the network rather than a clean task variable. Adding start_high==0, good==2 or prev_action==2 did not help, and swapping the choice for the logit band only reached dev F1 0.67. Recorded the simpler predicate using the agent upcoming choice (dev P 0.42, R 0.97, F1 0.59, mass recall 0.98).
